seo.title: Invoicing — New Nordic Way rf
seo.description: E-invoice address, operator and Business ID for New Nordic Way rf, the non-profit behind ODD, plus where to send PDF and paper invoices.

title: How to invoice us
intro: E-invoice first, PDF by email if you can't, paper only if you really must. Everything your invoicing software will ask for is on this page, with the Finnish term beside each one so you can copy it straight in.

sections.title: E-invoice
body: The quickest way to get paid. Send it here.

faq.q: Sending through a bank · Pankkiverkosta lähetettäessä
a: Operator ID DABAFIHH. Use it only if your software can't send to Maventa directly.

sections.title: PDF by email
body: Can't send e-invoices? Email the invoice as a PDF to our scanning service. A machine reads this inbox, not a person, so send invoices and nothing else.

a: One invoice per PDF, with any attachment pages inside the same file. Several invoices in one email is fine, as long as each file has its own name.
Real PDFs only (version 1.3 or newer), not locked or password-protected, A4 at most.
Name files with plain letters and numbers, a–z, A–Z and 0–9. No spaces, no special characters.
Keep the whole email under 5 MB.

sections.title: Paper invoice
body: If paper is the only way, post it to our scanning service, with the full address on both the invoice and the envelope. Invoices sent to any other address, our visiting address included, won't reach our accounts.

a: Send invoices only. Everything posted here is read straight into our accounts, so receipts, gifts, cards and tickets never reach a person.
Black text on white scans best. No staples.

sections.title: What every invoice needs
body: Your company name and Business ID or VAT number, the invoice date and number, what the invoice is for, the amount and the VAT, your bank account and the payment terms.
An invoice missing any of these comes back to you, which slows everyone down.

contact.title: Questions about an invoice
body: The scanning addresses above don't read messages. For a payment, a correction or anything else about an invoice, write to us and a person will answer.
